svg.title: StreamDecisionBench — in-force accuracy across update intervals
svg.desc: Fifteen single-model settings, six cloud APIs and nine self-hosted open-weight settings. Normalized log-AUC over update intervals of 0.5–8 seconds; one recorded pass per setting.
svg.text: The curves beneath the leaderboard score · Logarithmic interval weighting from 0.5 to 8 s
